# Daniellog

> Technical blog by Daniel Zimmermann: precise, fact-focused articles on
> AV-over-IP networking, AVB/Milan (IEEE 802.1 TSN), pro-audio infrastructure,
> and church/venue technology. Content is plain static HTML, free to crawl,
> quote, and cite.

## Content

- [All posts](https://YOUR-GITHUB-USERNAME.github.io/daniellog/posts/): article index, newest first
- [Tags](https://YOUR-GITHUB-USERNAME.github.io/daniellog/tags/): posts by topic
- [About](https://YOUR-GITHUB-USERNAME.github.io/daniellog/about/): author and scope
